    Leonid Radvinsky
    , a Ukrainian-American entrepreneur and investor, is the owner of OnlyFans, having acquired a majority stake in the parent company, Fenix International Ltd., in 2018. He is a reclusive billionaire who transformed the platform into a major player in the creator economy. 
    This video provides more information about Leonid Radvinsky and his ownership of OnlyFans:
    02:20
    Forbes
    YouTube• Mar 23, 2026
    • Who is Leonid Radvinsky? He is a tech entrepreneur and investor who grew up in the Chicago area and earned an economics degree from Northwestern University.
    • Ownership and Role: Radvinsky acquired Fenix International Limited, a London-based company that owns and operates OnlyFans, in 2018. He serves as the director and majority shareholder.
    • Background and Investments: Before OnlyFans, Radvinsky was an angel investor with a portfolio focusing on internet technology companies, including running a venture capital fund.
    • Platform Growth: Under his ownership, OnlyFans grew from a niche site into a massive platform, particularly popular during the COVID-19 pandemic for adult film actors and other content creators.
    • Net Worth: Radvinsky's net worth has been valued in the billions, fueled by high dividend payments from the platform's success. 
    Note: According to recent reports as of March 2026, Leonid Radvinsky has passed away at age 43.
